How the project's repository is organized, with its frontends: layout monorepo keeps the app, its frontends (web/&lt;name>, from blueprints such as spa) and the TypeScript client (clients/ts) in one repository, as an npm workspace, so that a change to the model, the API and a screen goes in one commit. task web:install installs every frontend's packages, task dev runs the API and the frontends together, task web:build builds them.

```esquadro
blueprint workspace
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [app](../app/): the app must use them too.
- **Works with** [client_ts](../client_ts/), [http](../http/), [docker](../docker/), [github_actions](../github_actions/) when the app uses them.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `layout` | name | `"monorepo"` | monorepo: everything in one repository. (polyrepo, each frontend in a repository of its own, is planned.) |

```esquadro
blueprint workspace {
  layout "monorepo"
}
```

## Hooks

- `post-gen` ignore, edits `.gitignore`
